newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one Sept 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one Sept 6.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on its front page on Sept. 6:
CHARLESTON, S.C. - Hurricane Fran slammed into southern North Carolina.
MOSCOW - Yeltsin announced he has agreed to heart surgery later this month following tests that showed he suffered from heart disease.
WASHINGTON - Clinton maintains double-digit lead over Republican challenger Dole in new Washington Post-ABC News poll.
NEW YORK - Ramzi Ahmed Yousef, alleged terrorist mastermind accused of scripting the World Trade Center bombing, and two co-defendents were convicted of plot to bomb 12 U.S. jumbo jets.

QALAT CHAWLAN, Iraq - Iraqi-backed Kurdish guerrillas launched new attack against their Kurdish rivals in northern Iraq and, further north, Turkish warplanes roard across the border to bomb a third Kurdish faction in mountain redoubts.
